s_szTacticsExplain: A Flame Digimon with small body size. Since the Digicore is burning furiously inside its body, it has appearance of flame.?
It is cowardly and digs a hole with its four feet and buries itself under the ground when it detects enemies. The sprout on its head is for the camouflage of a plant.?

Agumon is a Reptile type Digimon with a Flame attribute in its Rookie stage. This Digimon has two attack skills - the Baby Flame, which continuously shoots small flame balls; and the Baby Burner, which shoots a charged flame ball from its mouth.

Lalamon is a Plant type Digimon with an Earth attribute in its Rookie stage. This Digimon has three attack skills - the Nut Shooter, which fires hard grains from its mouth; the Lala Screw, which spins its head and leaves; and the Sing-a-Song, which makes the enemy sleepy.

Gaomon is a Beast type Digimon with a Wind attribute in its Rookie stage. This Digimon has three attack skills - the Spinning Double Backhand; the Rolling Upper, which uses fast spinning and a jump; and the Gao Rush, a continuous, rapid-punching attack.
Keenan Krier's Partner Digimon in its Rookie stage. It flies with large, well-developed wings. This Digimon usually accompanies Ninjas and uses its Scratch Smash Skill and Shuririnken.

A Reptile Digimon who has the ferocious personality of a carnivorous beast. The mark drawn on its abdomen is called the "Digital Hazard", which is inscribed on those that have the potential to cause massive damage to computer data.
An Animal Digimon whose appearance looks like a golden fox. It is practiced enough that it doesn't lose that composure in any situation.
A Reptile Digimon who has grown up and become able to walk on two legs. It is a being that foretells Digivolution to a great and powerful Digimon.
One of the Ancient Animal types of Digimon. This Digimon has the highest battle ability of any Rookie among the Ancient Animal type Digimon.

A Puppet Digimon, born from data leaking out of a?chess game. This generic yet mysterious pawn suddenly evolves with increasing experience and is capable of attaining the powers of a Mega Class Digimon. A competitor to?PawnChessmon (White)
A healthy Digimon with an easy-going nature. This Digimon uses its ear, which is split into three branches, as a hand.
A Digimon with a vicious personality that likes to fight. The horn growing behind it is said to be its weak point, but this definitely has no degree of truth.
A mammal Digimon with large ears. It can fly but walks much faster. It stays true to its word and is honest.

A pet-based holy type Digimon who was created by Digimon scientist. As it is still very young, it is unable to manifest its holy powers, and isn't even aware of its own mission. For that reason it is naturally insecure, so it can become either good or evil.?

A Digimon whose nature is polite, calm and cool. It is a descendant of a special species that flourished in ancient times, able to perform special Armor Digivolutions. Its head decoration came from?Garudamon.

A Digimon who looks like a baby angel. It was said that the Digimon appeared to bring order and peace to the World, while the Digimon World was still chaotic.

One of the four holy beasts which protect the digital world. It guards the south. It controls fire. Zhuqiaomon is especially wild among the four holy beasts so that it exterminates everything approaching it without a proper cause.

One of the Four Holy Beasts who protects the Digital World. It guards the East with fierce lightning. It is a legendary being like the other Four Holy Beasts. It is said its power can match that of a god. Also, it is regarded as one of the Four Great Dragons alongside Holydramon, Magnadramon, and Megidramon.

One of the four holy beasts which protect the digital world. It guards the north. It uses water skill. Xuanwumon is the oldest of the four holy beast digimons, and has gentle mind. All the four holy beast digimons have four eyes and twelve Digicores floating around their bodies.

One of the four holy beasts which protect the digital world. It has steel characteristics that protect the West. It has reigned since the mythical age and is legendary just like the other four holy beasts digimons, and its power is known to be almost as strong as god. It is the youngest of the four holy beasts digimons, but has the strongest power.
An Undead Digimon whose muscles have all rotted away. It tried to extend its life by mechanizing its body, but it destabilized its body, and its configuration data has begun to break down.
A mysterious Digimon that appeared when negative thoughts gathered through dark power. None know its true identity, and whether this thing is a Digimon cannot be analyzed.
Massive number of Kuramon have conflated and mutated into Armagemon. By unity of massive Kuramons, it gained the power that transcends Diablomon.

A Digimon that possesses power of Fire, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. The Digimon can freely control fire because spiritual fire, also known as sacred flame, surrounds the DigiCore.

A Digimon that possesses power of Fire, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It has skin that can withstand high temperatures, can move in lava, and is a fire fighter that can quench fire with sudden and explosive flames.

A Digimon that possesses power of Wind, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. The Digimon effortlessly controls the atmosphere to create mirages for its enemies and creates vacuums to attack with "Piercing Winds." It is more skilled in gaining intelligence than fighting and as a complete optimist, its strong will allows the Digimon to laugh away small difficulties.

A Digimon that possesses power of Wind, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. Since the Digimon looks like a calm female adult, it lures enemies with its languid behaviors but actually, it is has a devilish personality and is very fickle and enjoys putting people in difficult situations.

A Digimon that possesses power of Ice, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It claims to be a member of the Polar Region Defense Force of the Polar Army but the truth is unknown. it is survivalist knowledge is strong and reliable. The Digimon rarely acts on its own will and primarily operates in response to someone's requests or orders.

A Digimon that possesses power of Ice, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It is reckless and impulsive rather than brave and resolute. It is a wild Digimon that is determined and ambitious.

A Digimon that possesses power of Wood, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It is quiet and emotionless and therefore, it is impossible to guess its thoughts. Normally, it is treated literally as a wooden doll but once a battle begins, its tricky movements makes its enemies feel pain and humiliation.

A Digimon that possesses power of Wood, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. Its emotionless face makes it difficult to guess its thoughts but the Digimon has a huge appetite. It swallows everything with its tongue that looks like an ivy vine and makes the branches on its back grow.

A Digimon that possesses power of Earth, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. There are various weapons and defense mechanisms on its large hands and thick fingers. It hates receiving orders and frequently acts independently but follows orders from those whose intelligence it acknowledges.

A Digimon that possesses power of Earth, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It is a dirt giant created with earth or materials from the atmosphere. Compared to Grotmon, it is more arrogant and violent. It has Grotmon's personality of looking down on others and often considers battles to be boring and yawns frequently.

A Transcend Form Digimon with the power of fire exceeding that of Ten Legendary Warriors. It is said to contain the power of nine dragon veins flowing through the ground and can control the strength of nine dragons to rule Gaia with unfathomable power. It is said to wield 'Ryugonken', a sword which seals the spirits of the dragons, to control the power.

A Digimon that possesses power of Light, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. As a chivalrous Digimon who will lay down its life for its beliefs, it despises injustice. Lobomon might seem cold because it does not often speak and does not want to be associated with anyone, but it is a very warm and sweet warrior.

A Digimon that possesses power of Light, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It has super speed because it was discovered in an optical communications network and hates evil due to its just mind. It never follows anyone with even the slightest malice but once it pledges loyalty to someone, it will never betray that person.

A Digimon that possesses power of Thunder, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It has mechanical appearance contrariwise it has warm heart. Its battle type is close wrestler style, and it is not good at underwater circumstance.

A Digimon that possesses power of Thunder, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It has strong armor and receives enemy’s attack as a shield instead another colleague, however merciless attack through entire weapon is started when the damage reaches to its critical point.

A Digimon that possesses power of Water, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It has severe mood swings. When it is in good mood, it becomes like elegant lady, however when it is in bad mood, it becomes like newborn baby. Main battle style is indirect attack with water.

A Digimon that possesses power of Water, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It is half man and half beast. The character is impatient & crafty like witch. It attacks enemy with high-speed spinning of own tentacle and also defense oneself with it. When tentacle attack not gives any damage for the enemy, it changes one’s body into jumbo squid and increase the attack power.

A Digimon that possesses power of Darkness, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It became Duskmon by Cherubimon’s curse before. However Lowemon is actual form which is released from the curse, shadow of Ten warriors and pitch darkness warrior. Lowemon is executor to purify evils also with using Spear of conviction and Shield of atonement.

A Digimon that possesses power of Darkness, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. ‘Spirit of darkness’ appearance was changed into another by Cherubimon’s curse. However KaiserLeomon is actual form which is released from the curse. Its body covered by Obsidian Digizoid, so defensive power is quite high & sharp itself.

A Digimon that possesses power of Steel, which bears the might of legendary Ten Warriors. It plans various strategies at the same time. Always it talks to oneself to discuss everything and anytime. The strong both arms are called with “Shield of irony” which reflects enemy’s attack. Sometimes it hides own body in the shield.

It is able to analysis enemy’s weakness point in a twinkle. However, the character becomes own weakness point when it is in uncalculated situation. 10 spheres have same attribute with 10 warriors, so it use same attribute with enemy and can absorb enemy’s attack.
